definition_zh: 如此；因此；也；到这种程度
definition_en: to such a degree, for that reason, also, or in the way just mentioned
core_image: 雨大得几乎看不清路，人们只好待在家里
scene: 雨下得这么大，所以我们待在家里。It was raining so hard that we stayed home.
sceneCN: 这里 so 是「如此」（第 1 个义项）；句意：雨下得这么大，所以我们待在家里。

senses.title: To such a degree
senses.definition: to such a great degree
senses.definitionCN: 到如此大的程度
senses.example: It was raining so hard that we stayed home.
senses.exampleCN: 雨下得这么大，所以我们待在家里。
senses.why: This is the degree sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是程度义项。

senses.title: For that reason
senses.definition: for the reason just mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 由于刚才提到的原因
senses.example: It was late, so we went home.
senses.exampleCN: 天晚了，所以我们回家了。
senses.why: The degree often leads to a result.
senses.whyCN: 程度常常引出结果。

senses.title: Also
senses.definition: also, used after a short agreeing reply
senses.definitionCN: 也，用于简短表示同意的回答后
senses.example: She likes tea, and so do I.
senses.exampleCN: 她喜欢茶，我也是。
senses.why: A short so can repeat a whole idea.
senses.whyCN: 一个简短的 so 能重复整个意思。

senses.title: In this way
senses.definition: in the way or to the extent just shown
senses.definitionCN: 以刚才所示的方式或程度
senses.example: Hold the cup so, and it will not spill.
senses.exampleCN: 这样握住杯子，它就不会洒。
senses.why: So can point to a manner.
senses.whyCN: so 可以指某种方式。

intro.en: So comes from an Old English word meaning in this way.
intro.cn: so 来自古英语中意为「以这种方式」的词。

items.en: The form became so.

items.en: So long became a farewell.

definition_en: a substance used with water for washing, to rub with soap, or a continuing television drama
core_image: 一块放在水槽边的白色肥皂
scene: 洗手前先用肥皂。Use soap before you wash your hands.
sceneCN: 这里 soap 是「肥皂」（第 1 个义项）；句意：洗手前先用肥皂。

senses.title: Substance for washing
senses.definition: a substance that is used with water to clean things
senses.definitionCN: 与水合用来清洁物品的物质
senses.example: Use soap before you wash your hands.
senses.exampleCN: 洗手前先用肥皂。
senses.why: This is the basic cleaning sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的清洁义项。

senses.title: Rub with soap
senses.definition: to rub something with soap
senses.definitionCN: 用肥皂擦洗某物
senses.example: He soaped the car before rinsing it.
senses.exampleCN: 他冲洗前先给车打上肥皂。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of cleaning.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为清洁动词。

senses.title: Continuing TV drama
senses.definition: a television drama about the daily lives of the same characters

senses.example: My grandmother watches a soap every evening.

senses.whyCN: soap opera 被简称为 soap。

definition_en: relating to society, to meeting other people, or to living in groups
core_image: 公园里人们三五成群地交谈
scene: 住房是重要的社会问题。Housing is an important social issue.
sceneCN: 这里 social 是「社会的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：住房是重要的社会问题。

senses.title: Of society
senses.definition: relating to society and the way people live together
senses.definitionCN: 与社会以及人们共同生活的方式相关的
senses.example: Housing is an important social issue.
senses.exampleCN: 住房是重要的社会问题。
senses.why: This is the broad sense covering public life.
senses.whyCN: 这是涵盖公共生活的宽泛义项。

senses.title: Of meeting people
senses.definition: relating to meeting friends and spending time with others
senses.definitionCN: 与见朋友、与他人共度时光相关的
senses.example: She has a busy social life.
senses.exampleCN: 她的社交生活很忙。
senses.why: The word also names personal contact.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也指个人之间的交往。

senses.title: Living in groups
senses.definition: living in groups rather than alone
senses.definitionCN: 成群生活而非独居的
senses.example: Bees are social insects.

senses.whyCN: 生物学用这个词表示群体生活。

definition_zh: 以某种方式；不知怎么地
definition_en: in a way that is not known or not stated
core_image: 一辆旧车摇摇晃晃，却还是开到了山顶
scene: 我们总能想办法把箱子搬上楼。We will get the box upstairs somehow.
sceneCN: 这里 somehow 是「以某种方式」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们总能想办法把箱子搬上楼。

pos.zh: 不知怎么地；莫名其妙地

senses.title: By some means
senses.definition: in a way that is not stated but is possible
senses.definitionCN: 以没有说明但可行的某种方式
senses.example: We will get the box upstairs somehow.
senses.exampleCN: 我们总能想办法把箱子搬上楼。
senses.why: Some plus how names a method left unnamed.
senses.whyCN: some 加 how，指一种没有说出的方法。

senses.title: For no clear reason
senses.titleCN: 不知怎么地；莫名其妙地
senses.definition: for a reason that is not known or understood
senses.definitionCN: 出于不知道或不理解的原因
senses.example: Somehow I knew she would call.
senses.exampleCN: 不知怎么地，我就知道她会打电话来。
senses.why: An unnamed way can also be an unexplained cause.
senses.whyCN: 未说明的方式，也可以指未解释的原因。

intro.en: Somehow joins some with the old word how.
intro.cn: somehow 把 some 与古老的 how 组合在一起。

items.en: Sum meant some; hu meant how.
items.cn: sum 意为一些，hu 意为如何。

items.en: The compound named an unnamed manner.
items.cn: 这个复合词指一种未说明的方式。

items.en: It came to mean by one means or another.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示「用这样或那样的办法」。

items.en: It also came to mean for an unknown reason.
items.cn: 它也开始表示「出于未知的原因」。

items.en: The phrase somehow or other fixed the first sense.
items.cn: somehow or other 这一说法固定了第一个义项。

note.en: Somehow is compared with look-alike words and adverbs of unspecified manner.
note.cn: 把 somehow 与形近词以及表示不确定方式的副词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Somehow says a way exists even when no one can name it.
normalIntro.cn: somehow 表示：即使没人说得出方法，办法仍然存在。

normal.en: We will get the box upstairs somehow.
normal.cn: 我们总能想办法把箱子搬上楼。

normal.en: Somehow I knew she would call.
normal.cn: 不知怎么地，我就知道她会打电话来。

normal.en: They somehow finished before noon.
normal.cn: 他们不知怎么在中午前完成了。

normal.en: Somehow or other, the door opened.
normal.cn: 不管怎样，门还是开了。

normal.en: He somehow found the lost ring.
normal.cn: 他不知怎么就找到了丢失的戒指。

abstract.en: Somehow is hope wearing the clothes of method.
abstract.cn: somehow 是穿上了方法外衣的希望。

abstract.en: Naming no way keeps every way open.
abstract.cn: 不说出办法，就是让所有办法都还敞开着。

abstract.en: The unexplained is not the impossible.
abstract.cn: 无法解释的，并不等于不可能。

examples.en: We will get the box upstairs somehow.

dict_mnemonic.text: somehow 是 some（某个）加 how（如何）：说不清「如何」，就用 somehow；somehow or other 是「不管怎样」，意思与 anyhow 接近。

root: 由 some（某个）与 how（如何）组合而成，核心义「以某种未说明的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: Somehow means by an unnamed means, or for an unknown reason.
sensesIntro.cn: somehow 意为以未说明的方式，或出于未知的原因。

core.en: A way or cause that is left unnamed.
core.cn: 一种未说明的方式或原因。

branches.en: A heavy box still reaches the top floor.
branches.cn: 沉重的箱子还是被弄上了顶楼。

branches.en: A phone rings just before it is expected.
branches.cn: 电话恰在预料之前响起。

branches.en: An unnamed method and an unnamed cause share one word.
branches.cn: 未说明的方法与未说明的原因共用一个词。

branches.en: Somehow or other leaves all methods open.
branches.cn: somehow or other 把所有方法都保留着。

branches.en: What cannot be explained can still be done.
branches.cn: 解释不了的事，照样能做到。

intro.en: Somehow belongs to the some- family of unnamed ways and places.
intro.cn: somehow 属于由 some 构成、表示未知方式与地点的词族。

latinIntro.en: Somehow has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: somehow 没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。

definition_en: a person who is not named or known, or an important person
core_image: 门口站着一个看不清面孔的人影
scene: 有人在门口等你。Someone is waiting for you at the door.
sceneCN: 这里 someone 是「某人；有人」（第 1 个义项）；句意：有人在门口等你。

senses.title: An unnamed person
senses.definition: a person who is not named or not known
senses.definitionCN: 没有被指名或不认识的人
senses.example: Someone is waiting for you at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 有人在门口等你。
senses.why: Some plus one names a single person without a name.
senses.whyCN: some 加 one，指一个没有名字的人。

senses.title: An important person
senses.definition: a person of importance or fame
senses.definitionCN: 有地位或名气的人
senses.example: He is someone in the music world.
senses.exampleCN: 他在音乐界是个重要人物。
senses.why: A person can become someone who matters.
senses.whyCN: 一个普通人可以变成举足轻重的人。

intro.en: Someone joins some with the word one.
intro.cn: someone 把 some 与 one 组合在一起。

items.en: Sum meant some; an meant one.
items.cn: sum 意为一些，an 意为一。

items.en: The compound named a single unknown person.
items.cn: 这个复合词指单个不认识的人。

items.en: Someone grew common alongside somebody.
items.cn: someone 与 somebody 一起变得常见。

items.en: It also came to name a person of importance.
items.cn: 它也开始指重要人物。

items.en: It is slightly more formal than somebody in many uses.
items.cn: 在许多用法中它比 somebody 略正式。

note.en: Someone is compared with look-alike words and words for unknown people.
note.cn: 把 someone 与形近词以及表示未知人物的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Someone points to one person and leaves the name blank.
normalIntro.cn: someone 指向一个人，却把名字留空。

normal.en: Someone is waiting for you at the door.
normal.cn: 有人在门口等你。

normal.en: He is someone in the music world.
normal.cn: 他在音乐界是个重要人物。

normal.en: Someone else has taken my seat.
normal.cn: 别人坐了我的位子。

normal.en: Someone called your name outside.
normal.cn: 外面有人喊你的名字。

normal.en: She needs someone to talk to.
normal.cn: 她需要一个能说说话的人。

abstract.en: Someone is a place kept open for a face.
abstract.cn: someone 是一个为某张面孔留出的位置。

abstract.en: Every crowd is made of someones.
abstract.cn: 每一群人都是由一个个「某人」组成的。

abstract.en: The unknown person is still a person.
abstract.cn: 不认识的人，仍然是一个人。

examples.en: Someone is waiting for you at the door.

examples.en: She needs someone to talk to.
examples.cn: 她需要一个能说说话的人。

dict_mnemonic.text: someone 就是 some（某个）加 one（一个）：一个不知道名字的人；它与 somebody 基本同义，be someone 是「成为重要人物」。

root: 由 some（某个）与 one（一个）组合而成，核心义「某一个未指名的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Someone means an unnamed or unknown person, or a person of importance.

core.en: One person, name left open.
core.cn: 一个人，名字留空。

branches.en: A figure waits in the doorway.

branches.en: An unknown person may already be important.
branches.cn: 一个不认识的人，可能已经很了不起。

branches.en: Someone and somebody often exchange places.
branches.cn: someone 与 somebody 经常互换位置。

branches.en: Importance is a name others learn to know.
branches.cn: 重要，就是一个别人逐渐记住的名字。

intro.en: Someone belongs to the some- family of unnamed people and things.
intro.cn: someone 属于由 some 构成、表示未知人与物的词族。

latinIntro.en: Someone has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: someone 没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。

items.example: Someone is somewhere in the building.

definition_en: a thing that is not named or known, or a thing of value
core_image: 桌上放着一个盖着布的盒子，看不清里面是什么
scene: 我听到厨房里有东西掉了下来。I heard something fall in the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 something 是「某物；某事」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我听到厨房里有东西掉了下来。

pos.zh: 重要的事物；有价值的东西

senses.title: An unnamed thing
senses.definition: a thing that is not named or not known
senses.definitionCN: 没有被说出或不了解的事物
senses.example: I heard something fall in the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 我听到厨房里有东西掉了下来。
senses.why: Some plus thing names an object while leaving it blank.
senses.whyCN: some 加 thing，指一个事物，却把内容留空。

senses.title: A thing that matters
senses.definition: a thing of value or importance
senses.definitionCN: 有价值或重要的事物
senses.example: She wants to build something with her life.
senses.exampleCN: 她想用自己的一生做出点事业。
senses.why: An unnamed thing can be a thing worth having.
senses.whyCN: 没有指名的事物，也可以值得拥有。

senses.title: About, rather like
senses.definition: used before a number or description to mean about or rather like
senses.definitionCN: 用于数字或描述前，表示大约或有点像
senses.example: The trip took something like five hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅程大约用了五个小时。
senses.why: An unnamed thing becomes an approximate description.
senses.whyCN: 未指名的事物变成了近似的描述。

intro.en: Something joins some with the word thing.
intro.cn: something 把 some 与 thing 组合在一起。

items.en: Sum meant some; thing meant an object or matter.
items.cn: sum 意为一些，thing 意为东西或事情。

items.en: The compound named an unnamed object.
items.cn: 这个复合词指一个未指名的东西。

items.en: It came to mean a thing of value.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示有价值的东西。

items.en: It also came to mean about or rather like.
items.cn: 它也开始表示大约或有点像。

items.en: It is now one of the most common pronouns.
items.cn: 它如今是最常用的代词之一。

note.en: Something is compared with look-alike words and words for unknown objects.
note.cn: 把 something 与形近词以及表示未知事物的词作比较。

entries.definition: a thing that can be seen or touched

normalIntro.cn: something 指一个东西，却把它盖在布底下。

normal.cn: 我听到厨房里有东西掉了下来。

normal.en: Let us get something to eat.
normal.cn: 我们去吃点东西吧。

abstract.en: Something is how we speak of what we cannot yet name.
abstract.cn: something 是我们谈论「还叫不出名字的东西」的方式。

abstract.en: Every discovery begins as something.
abstract.cn: 每一个发现，开始时都只是「某个东西」。

abstract.en: The unnamed thing is often the important one.
abstract.cn: 没有名字的那个东西，往往才是重要的。

examples.en: Let us get something to eat.

sensesIntro.en: Something means an unnamed thing, a thing of importance, or about and rather like.
sensesIntro.cn: something 意为未指名的事物、重要的事物，或大约、有点像。

core.en: A thing held in mind but not named.
core.cn: 心里有、却没有名字的东西。

branches.en: A sound comes from the next room.
branches.cn: 隔壁房间传来一个声响。

branches.en: A life is spent building one good thing.
branches.cn: 一生用来做成一件好东西。

branches.en: A trip lasts roughly five hours.
branches.cn: 旅程大约持续五个小时。

branches.en: An unknown thing may become a valuable one.
branches.cn: 未知的东西可能变成宝贵的东西。

branches.en: Something great often starts as something like an idea.
branches.cn: 了不起的事物，常常从一个「像想法一样的东西」开始。

intro.en: Something belongs to the some- family of unnamed things and people.
intro.cn: something 属于由 some 构成、表示未知事物的词族。

latinIntro.en: Something has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: something 没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。

definition_en: on some occasions but not always
core_image: 同一条路，晴天有人走，雨天也有人走
scene: 我有时走路去上班。I sometimes walk to work.
sceneCN: 这里 sometimes 是「有时」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我有时走路去上班。

senses.title: On some occasions
senses.definition: on some occasions but not on others
senses.definitionCN: 在某些场合，而不是所有场合
senses.example: I sometimes walk to work.
senses.exampleCN: 我有时走路去上班。
senses.why: Some plus times marks an unstated number of occasions.
senses.whyCN: some 加 times，标出未说明次数的场合。

senses.title: In certain cases
senses.definition: in certain situations or under certain conditions
senses.definitionCN: 在某些情形或条件下
senses.example: The word is sometimes used as a verb.
senses.exampleCN: 这个词有时被用作动词。
senses.why: Occasions can also be situations.
senses.whyCN: 场合也可以是情形。

intro.en: Sometimes joins some with the plural of time.
intro.cn: sometimes 把 some 与 time 的复数组合在一起。

items.en: Sum meant some; tima meant time.
items.cn: sum 意为一些，tima 意为时间。

items.en: The compound named certain occasions.
items.cn: 这个复合词指某些场合。

items.en: It settled as the adverb for occasional action.
items.cn: 它固定为表示偶尔发生的副词。

items.en: It is often contrasted with always and never.
items.cn: 它常与 always 和 never 相对。

items.en: The single-word sometime kept a different meaning.
items.cn: 单数形式的 sometime 保留了不同的含义。

note.en: Sometimes is compared with look-alike words and adverbs of frequency.
note.cn: 把 sometimes 与形近词以及表示频率的副词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sometimes marks the occasions that are not every time.
normalIntro.cn: sometimes 标出「不是每一次」的那些场合。

normal.en: I sometimes walk to work.
normal.cn: 我有时走路去上班。

normal.en: The word is sometimes used as a verb.
normal.cn: 这个词有时被用作动词。

normal.en: Sometimes the train is late.
normal.cn: 火车有时会晚点。

normal.en: She sometimes calls on Sunday.
normal.cn: 她有时星期天打电话来。

normal.en: Sometimes even experts make mistakes.
normal.cn: 有时连专家也会犯错。

abstract.en: Sometimes is the adverb of the unfinished pattern.
abstract.cn: sometimes 是「尚未形成规律」的副词。

abstract.en: Not always is not the same as never.
abstract.cn: 「不总是」并不等于「从不」。

abstract.en: Occasions are the rooms time opens now and then.
abstract.cn: 场合，是时间偶尔打开的房间。

examples.en: I sometimes walk to work.
examples.cn: 我有时走路去上班。

examples.en: Sometimes the train is late.
examples.cn: 火车有时会晚点。

examples.en: She sometimes calls on Sunday.
examples.cn: 她有时星期天打电话来。

dict_mnemonic.text: sometimes 就是 some（某些）加 times（次、时候）：某些时候会这样，就是「有时」；注意 sometime 是「某个时候」，some time 是「一段时间」。

root: 由 some（某些）与 times（次数、时候）组合而成，核心义「在某些场合发生」。

sensesIntro.en: Sometimes means on some occasions, or in certain situations.
sensesIntro.cn: sometimes 意为在某些场合，或在某些情形下。

core.en: Not every time, but more than never.
core.cn: 不是每次，但也不从不。

branches.en: A walk happens on dry days.
branches.cn: 天晴的日子里会走路去。

branches.en: A word changes its part of speech in some cases.
branches.cn: 一个词在某些情形下改变词性。

branches.en: Occasions and cases both mark the not-always.
branches.cn: 场合与情形都标出「并非总是」。

branches.en: Sometimes sits between often and rarely.
branches.cn: sometimes 坐在 often 与 rarely 之间。

branches.en: A rule with exceptions is a rule sometimes broken.
branches.cn: 有例外的规则，就是一条有时被打破的规则。

intro.en: Sometimes belongs to the some- family of time and place words.
intro.cn: sometimes 属于由 some 构成、表示时间与地点的词族。

latinIntro.en: Sometimes has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: sometimes 没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。
